Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: illustrative temporary hero photograph for a fitness website, only a photograph, no UI.
Primary request: hyper-realistic editorial photograph of an imagined contemporary Brazilian gym, empty and without people.
Scene/backdrop: realistic gym interior with black strength-training machines and red equipment details.
Composition/framing: horizontal 1536x1024, wide view, equipment concentrated in the center and right, with deep shadow and uncluttered dark negative space in the left third for future webpage text.
Lighting/mood: natural light entering from the side, strong contrast, intense training atmosphere.
Materials/textures: matte black metal, textured black rubber flooring, subtle natural wear.
Constraints: invented illustrative setting, not a depiction of any actual gym. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Do not render a website, UI, border or collage.
